micro.purpose: Minimal HUD status and unit indicators (10px).

math.purpose: Mathematical physics variables and kinematic equations.

telemetry.purpose: Real-time measurements, timestamps, and graph ticks.

narrative.northStar: Precision Laboratory Instrument and Modern Scientific Editorial
narrative.overview: A high-density, rigorous educational physics workstation designed for secondary students and educators studying linear kinematics and free fall under the Iraqi curriculum.
keyCharacteristics: Dark laboratory workstation aesthetic in deep slate and obsidian.
Chromatic separation of physical roles: Velocity in Rose, Gravity in Sky, Height in Amber.
Tri-font typographic architecture: Arabic UI, STIX Two Text Math, JetBrains Mono Telemetry.
Dual-rate cognitive synchronization: 60fps canvas coupled with 15Hz throttled telemetry.

rules.name: The Single-Role Color Rule
rules.body: Rose is velocity, Sky is gravity, Amber is height. Never use them for decorative flair.

rules.name: The Strict Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every variable updating over time must use tabular-nums in JetBrains Mono to prevent jitter.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; depth is created by high-contrast tonal stepping rather than blurry shadows.

dos: Do isolate mathematical equations in LTR containers with MathText.
Do keep g = -10 m/s^2, vi = 0, and t = 3.0s immutable across all views.
Do throttle React UI updates to 15Hz while running Three.js at 60fps.
donts: Don't use emojis anywhere in the interface or scene overlays.
Don't use pastel gradients, floating pill badges, or glassmorphic blur effects.
Don't introduce air resistance, parabolic projectile math, or bouncing mechanics outside textbook Example 3.
